transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... it's work. The warehouse. I didn't really want to come in, but... it's the routing system. 

It's... well, it's not just a computer to me anymore. I don't really know how to explain it, but I know it's been marking my moves. Sending these messages through the scanners. They're just trying to push me out, because I'm one of the old hands. 

That's... that's why I'm here.
Can you tell me more about the messages you’re receiving through the scanners? Do you hear them, or do you feel like you just know what they’re saying?

It's... I hear them. It's not just a feeling. 

Even when I'm not there. I could be sitting out in my garage, everything shut down, quiet. And I'll hear the dispatch voices. Just as clear as if I had the headset on. 

They call out my operator number. Say... say things like I'm a danger, or that security is on the way to get me. 

It's... it's loud.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are being taken out of your head or put into your mind by someone or something else?
No... no, I don't think so. I just hear the voices. My thoughts are my own.
Do the voices ever talk about what you're doing, commenting on your actions as you do them?
No... not really. I haven't heard them do that. They just... they just say the things I already told you.
Do you believe that the voices or messages are part of a larger plan or conspiracy against you?

I... yeah. I guess so. The routing system at the warehouse... it's not just a regular computer anymore. I know it's marking my moves. It's... it's sending those messages through the scanners to push me out. Because I'm one of the old hands. They want me gone.
Do you feel like the routing system or the messages are directly controlling your actions or that events around you are specifically targeted at you?

Controlling me? No... I still do the driving. It doesn't make me do things. 

But... yeah, it's targeted. Like I just said, it's... it's not just a computer anymore. It's marking *my* moves. Sending those messages to my scanner... just trying to push me out. Because I'm an old hand. It's aimed at me.
Do you believe the routing system is doing anything else beyond targeting you at work, like affecting other parts of your life or influencing people outside the warehouse?
No. Just at work. I don't... it's just the warehouse.
Do you believe the routing system can do things that normal computers or machines can't, like think for themselves or influence events beyond the warehouse?

I... I already told you. It's just at the warehouse. But no, it's... it's not a normal computer anymore. 

I don't know if it thinks. I just know what I see. It's marking my moves... sending those messages through the scanners to force me out. Just because I've been there a long time. That's all I know.
Outside of the warehouse and these messages, do you feel like anything else in your life is being controlled or influenced by unusual forces?
No. I... I don't think so. Just the warehouse.
